🔗 DotConnect

Numbered dots are scattered across the canvas — connect them in the correct numerical order to reveal a hidden picture. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Start at dot 1 and connect to dot 2, then 3, and so on.
  2. Click or tap dots in order — numbers must be sequential.
  3. Lines are drawn between correctly connected dots.
  4. The image gradually reveals as you complete the sequence.
  5. Some puzzles have multiple separate drawings to complete.
